name: Bleed
why: Every blood skill's fuel starts here. Kept (EN 1.9). From Life: only the living bleed.

name: Drink
why: Kept (EN 3.5). It fills held blood, the berserker's meter. Never heals.

name: Spill
meaning: give it out, as a weapon or a gift

name: Clot
meaning: blood hardens: armour, blades, a stopped wound
why: Kept (EN 2.66). It is already the conjured-weapon rune: Clotblade now conjures cleavers.

name: Thin
effect: speed x1.25; reach x1.1; power x0.9

name: Pulse
meaning: the heart pounds - your own, in frenzy
effect: windup x0.8; power x1.1; reflux x1.1
why: Turned inward: the heart that pounds is the berserker's own (Red Frenzy), not the enemy's (Hammering Heart, dropped). Role and draw kept (EN 2.2); the effect already reads as frenzy (quicker, harder, hotter).

name: Still
why: Kept (EN 3.1). From Death: the heart slowing toward its end.

name: Thirst
meaning: hunger for blood: the drive that reaches for it
why: The role needs a second conjured weapon and a reason to fight empty. Draws on Life (the living's blood wanted) and Death (a reaping reach). Link: it reaches out and passes on; outward (the hunger goes out after blood), EN = 2.5 - 0.4 x 1.0 = 2.1. As a means: quicker and longer, the hungry reach.

name: Sate
meaning: drink a body to the dregs: finish it and take all its blood
why: Thirst's opposite: the hunger ended. Draws on Death's Kill (finish the dying; Kill is a cap at EN 4.0). Cap, strongly inward, EN = 2.5 + 0.9 x 1.5 = 3.85. As a means: harder on the Dying and on the bleeding.
